message.content: {"caption":"Workflow diagram of generating, evaluating, and learning from alternative self-edits to a language model.","description":"A process diagram shows a starting context (Ctx, in a blue box) entering a language model with parameters θ_t. The model branches into three candidate self-edits, SE₁, SE₂, and SE₃. Each candidate points to an Optimize step with its loss, 𝓛(SEᵢ, θ_t), and then to a corresponding updated parameter set, θ′ᵢ. To the right of a vertical divider, each candidate is tested: a “Test” input and blue input block feed a language model with θ′ᵢ, which produces an answer (Ans) in a blue box. The first and second answers have check marks; the third has a cross. A curly brace groups these evaluation outcomes. The RL Data box shows a tuple containing the state (Ctx and θ_t), action (SE), and reward (✓/✗). The grouped rewards and RL data are associated with a Policy Update that produces θ_{t+1}.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
